newsitem.title: USA: Newpark Resources sets two acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Newpark Resources sets two acquisitions.

text.p: Newpark Resources Inc said Tuesday it has agreed to acquire two related drilling fluids companies, Chemical Technologies Inc and FMI Wholesale Drilling Fluids U.S.A. LP, in exchange for 111,000 Newpark common shares.
The purchases have a combined value of about $5.5 million and are expected to close by the end of the month.
Chief executive James D. Cole said these companies complement SBM Drilling Fluids Management Inc, which Newpark acquired in February, expanding its market to South Texas.

"Their operations will enable us to serve the entire Gulf Coast market and provide us with the added distribution capacity to realize the full benefit of recycling critical minerals from spent drilling fluids processed in our (nonhazardous oilfield waste) business," Cole said.

He said the acquisitions would be accretive to Newpark's per share earnings based upon the company's existing operations, before any benefit from the sale of recycled material. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
